def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.__getitem__)
    line=max({k for k in cnt if k!=bg},key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    mc={k for k in cnt if k not in (bg,line)}
    srow=[i for i in range(h) if not any(g[i][j]==bg for j in range(w)) and i!=h-1]
    scol=[j for j in range(w) if not any(g[i][j]==bg for i in range(h)) and j!=w-1]
    out=[]
    for a in range(len(srow)-1):
        rr=[]
        for b in range(len(scol)-1):
            c=[g[srow[a]][scol[b]],g[srow[a]][scol[b+1]],g[srow[a+1]][scol[b]],g[srow[a+1]][scol[b+1]]]
            rr.append(c[0] if len(set(c))==1 else bg)
        out.append(rr)
    return out
for n in (1,2,3):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    o=f(gi)
    print(n, o==go, json.dumps(o) if o!=go else '')
print('test:', json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); g2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; go2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
hf_,wf_=len(g2),len(g2[0])
cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in g2 for v in r); ff=max(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
sr=[i for i in range(hf_) if not any(g2[i][j]==ff for j in range(wf_))]
sc=[j for j in range(wf_) if not any(g2[i][j]==ff for i in range(hf_))]
print('fill',ff,'sr',sr,'sc',sc)
# print block interiors for row-band 0
for b in range(5):
    blk=g2[sr[0]+1:sr[1]][sc[b]+1:sc[b+1]]
    c=collections.Counter(v for r in blk for v in r)
    # find any non-bg, non-line cell
    print(b, dict(c))

import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lc=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if sum(g[i][j]==lc for j in range(w))/w>=0.9]
    sc=[j for j in range(w) if sum(g[i][j]==lc for i in range(h))/h>=0.9]
    sr=[x for x in sorted(sr)]; sc=[x for x in sorted(sc)]
    o=[]
    for a in range(len(sr)-1):
        row=[]
        for b_ in range(len(sc)-1):
            vals={g[sr[a]][sc[b_]],g[sr[a]][sc[b_+1]],g[sr[a+1]][sc[b_]],g[sr[a+1]][sc[b_+1]]}
            # output: the non-line, non-bg value among corners, else bg
            cands={v for v in vals if v!=lc and v!=bg}
            row.append(cands.pop() if len(cands)==1 else bg)
        o.append(row)
    return o,lc,bg,sr,sc
for n in [1,2,3]:
    go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    got,l,bb,sr,sc=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    print(f'demo{n}: lc={l} bg={bb} H={sr} V={sc}')
    print('match:',got==go,'got:',got)

def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def solve(g, frac=0.6):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: most common non-bg color forming full lines; choose the color with a complete run of >= w/2 consecutive same-color? Just pick most frequent non-bg
    lc=max([v for v,_ in cnt.most_common() if v!=bg],key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if sum(x==lc for x in g[i])/w>=frac]
    sc=[j for j in range(w) if sum(g[i][j]==lc for i in range(h))/h>=frac]
    out=[]
    for a in range(len(sr)-1):
        row=[]
        for b_ in range(len(sc)-1):
            vals={g[sr[a]][sc[b_]],g[sr[a]][sc[b_+1]],g[sr[a+1]][sc[b_]],g[sr[a+1]][sc[b_+1]]}
            nonlc={v for v in vals if v!=lc}
            uniq={v for v in nonlc}-{bg}  # remove bg too
            res=None
            if len(uniq)==1: res=list(uniq)[0]
            row.append(res if res is not None else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out,bg,lc,sr,sc
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    got,bg,lc,sr,sc=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    print(f'demo{n}: bg={bg} lc={lc} H={sr} V={sc}')
